## Delinea Platform — Secret Server Vault Activity

Privileged secret access and vault activity from the Delinea Platform (`DelineaAuditEvents_CL`). Shows which secrets are accessed, by whom, and from where.

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type), EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), SourceIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress) | where ServiceType == 'Secret Server' or EventName has 'Vault' | summarize VaultEvents = count(), DistinctSecrets = dcount(SecretId), DistinctUsers = dcount(Actor), SourceIPs = dcount(SourceIP) | project Metrics = pack_array('Vault events', 'Distinct secrets', 'Distinct users', 'Source IPs'), Values = pack_array(VaultEvents, DistinctSecrets, DistinctUsers, SourceIPs) | mv-expand Metric = Metrics to typeof(string), Value = Values to typeof(long) | project Metric, Value
content.title: Vault activity summary

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type), EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), n = parse_json(tostring(d.notes)) | where ServiceType == 'Secret Server' or EventName has 'Vault' | extend Action = coalesce(tostring(n.eventAction), tostring(d.eventType.name)) | summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Action
content.title: Secret activity over time (by action)

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type), EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), SourceIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress) | where ServiceType == 'Secret Server' or EventName has 'Vault' | where isnotempty(SecretId) | summarize Accesses = count(), DistinctUsers = dcount(Actor), Users = make_set(Actor, 25), SourceIPs = dcount(SourceIP), LastAccess = max(TimeGenerated) by Secret = SecretId | top 25 by Accesses
content.title: Most-accessed secrets

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type), EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), Actor = tostring(d.actor.name) | where ServiceType == 'Secret Server' or EventName has 'Vault' | where isnotempty(Actor) | summarize Accesses = count(), DistinctSecrets = dcount(SecretId) by Actor | top 15 by Accesses
content.title: Top users accessing secrets

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type), EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), n = parse_json(tostring(d.notes)) | where ServiceType == 'Secret Server' or EventName has 'Vault' | extend Action = coalesce(tostring(n.eventAction), tostring(d.eventType.name)) | summarize Count = count() by Action
content.title: Action breakdown

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type), EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), SourceIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress), n = parse_json(tostring(d.notes)) | where ServiceType == 'Secret Server' or EventName has 'Vault' | extend Action = coalesce(tostring(n.eventAction), tostring(d.eventType.name)), Details = tostring(n.eventDetails), Container = tostring(n.containerName) | project TimeGenerated, User = Actor, Secret = SecretId, Action, Details, Container, SourceIP | sort by TimeGenerated desc | take 200
content.title: Recent secret access detail
